_comment: Hand-maintained launch plan (the /pm chat updates it). NOT generated. code/tools/meta_coverage.py reads it, evaluates every gate that names a `metric` (a dotted path into latest.json; `list[key]` selects a row by its set/archetype/card id) against the fresh report, and embeds the result in latest.json and dashboard.html. Gates without a metric are judged by hand via `met`. Thresholds are proposals; change them here.
goal: Optimize Digimon TCG decklists for the live meta (as DigiLab and DigimonMeta measure it) by training agents on a simulator that plays that meta faithfully.

milestones.name: Measure the gap
milestones.why: Coverage of the whole card pool says nothing about readiness; coverage of the decks people register does.

gates.label: Meta coverage report + dashboard regenerate from repo data
BT26 field shares transcribed from DigiLab (data/meta_shares.json)

actions: PYTHONPATH=code python -m tools.meta_coverage --trend --html after each card batch

milestones.name: Make the BT26 field playable
milestones.why: BT26 carries about a fifth of every card the field registers and has no implementations, so most top decks cannot be simulated at all.

gates.label: Field share of fully playable decks
BT26 cards seen in meta lists that are implemented
Deck library holds at least 300 BT26-window lists

actions: Refresh the deck library first: python code/tools/meta_loader.py --scrape-dcg-nexus --dcg-nexus-since 2026-09-12
Author in implement_next order (12 cards reach 25% of the field, 33 reach 50%, 74 reach 75%), via /author-set BT26 or /batch-implement-cards-rust-dsl per archetype
Start with the shared TS package (Mervamon, Aegiochusmon Dark/Holy, Kanan Yuki, Shota Kuroi, Jupitermon DUAL): it feeds Jupitermon, Chronomon, TS Mervamon and TS Toolbox at once

milestones.name: Let training see the meta
milestones.why: The training deck pool admits an archetype only when a free-form ledger label matches its library name, so most fully playable meta decks are invisible to it.

gates.label: Playable decks the training pool rejects (field share)
Implemented cards missing from the deck-builder allowlist

actions: Replace gauntlet._load_fully_implemented_archetypes with a per-deck check: every card registered and none PARTIAL/BLOCKED
Regenerate data/tested_cards.json (python code/tools/build_tested_cards.py) so the deck builder offers every implemented card

milestones.name: Verify what the field plays
milestones.why: An agent learns whatever the engine does, including its mistakes. The DCGO exam is the independent check, and today it covers mostly Three Musketeers and Toho Braves.

gates.label: Meta card copies that are DCGO-verified
Clauses confirmed, weighted by how often the field plays each card

actions: Run /archetype-campaign on TS Jupitermon, Glowing Dawn, Data Squad and Chronomon (largest unmeasured field share)
Work the exam_next queue top-down: it is ordered by field play rate times unmeasured clauses

milestones.name: Meta training pilot
milestones.why: Spend training compute once the pool is playable, admitted and checked.

gates.label: Field share the training pool can use
2026-07-02 anchored baselines re-measured on the current engine
A BT26 generalist clears 55% anchored vs greedy and the frozen champions

actions: Cut a fresh training image (the published one predates exploiter_cli.py)
Re-run the anchored panel and exploiter for the three baseline agents
Train a generalist on the trainable BT26 pool; promote only on anchored evaluation

milestones.name: Deck optimization loop
milestones.why: The goal: rank decklist variants against the live meta and keep pace with each release.

gates.label: Architect agent ranks list variants against a BT26 gauntlet
Training runs (training_run.json, anchored_evals.jsonl) charted on this dashboard

actions: Per release (EX13 is already appearing in DCG Nexus events): /author-set with the DCGO keyword gate in week one, then exam, then retrain

training.summary: The harness works on the six starter decks. No agent has been trained on meta decks, and the baselines predate most of the current engine.

facts.label: Harness proven on starters
facts.detail: Three generalists trained on ST-1..6 beat the greedy bot 59-61% (n=300 each, seat-balanced, recorded 2026-07-02).

facts.label: Agents are exploitable
facts.detail: A 1M-step PPO exploiter beats each of them 70-75% of the time (a lower bound). Robustness, not just skill, needs a target.

facts.label: Baselines are stale
facts.detail: Training code last changed 2026-07-04; 126 engine and DSL commits have landed since. Re-measure before comparing a new run to these numbers.

facts.label: Run charts
facts.detail: TensorBoard (docker-compose.watch.yml) and the training MCP read runs/. Each run writes training_run.json and anchored_evals.jsonl, but nothing charts them yet, and the admin Arena page runs on placeholder worker jobs.

facts.label: Training image
facts.detail: The published image predates exploiter_cli.py (it was hand-patched into training-v0.46). Cut a fresh one before the next run.

training.baselines_source: openspec/changes/add-determinized-search/baselines.md (n=300 per cell, decks pinned to the starter pool)

findings.title: DigiLab database password is committed
findings.detail: code/server/digilab_client.py and code/tools/meta_loader.py hard-code an owner-level connection string for DigiLab's Postgres.
findings.action: Ask DigiLab to rotate it, read DIGILAB_CONN_STR from the environment only, and prefer their public API (api.digilab.cards; free key from their Discord #api channel).

findings.title: Card authoring stalled for two months
findings.detail: One new card spec landed between 2026-07-09 and 2026-09-11 (813 to 814) while the DCGO exam was built. BT26 released 2026-09-04, inside that gap.
findings.action: Split capacity: one lane authors cards in implement_next order, the other runs exam campaigns.

findings.title: Clause extractor loses text for 7 meta cards
findings.detail: LM-057..061 and P-240/P-244 have official-DB bundles with empty text_sections, which win over cards.json, so their clause denominator is 0.
findings.action: Fall back to cards.json text when a bundle's text_sections is empty (tools/clause_coverage/card_sources.py).

findings.title: Next set is weeks away
findings.detail: DCG Nexus already lists EX13-format events (2026-09-28, 2026-10-02). BT26 put 74 of its 104 cards into tournament lists within its first week.
findings.action: Run /author-set EX13 with the DCGO keyword gate as soon as its card list is public.
